builds.name: Aether Raids Offense
builds.desc: Both Atk Smoke and Speed Smoke can add 7 damage to Broadleaf Fan's scaling, so this depends on your support unit. If you are being supported by a Temari + user, Panic Smoke 3 is the best C Skill. If you are being supported by someone who already add's Panic, like Aversa, then Panic Smoke 3 is not recommended. The reason anyone would pick Chad to inherit Broadleaf Fan+ would be because at max investment and 2 Mythics, Chad avoids Lv.5 Panic Manor (Without Summoner Support). He is also in the 3/4 Star pool while someone like Kronya costs Grails.
